matches.why: Kirchberg's norm-ultrapower embedding question into O_2^ω concerns embeddability of full group C*-algebras into ultrapowers, closely related to Kirchberg's QWEP and Connes embedding circle of problems.
Constructs an operator with no nontrivial hyperinvariant subspace on separable Hilbert space, settling the hyperinvariant-subspace variant of the invariant subspace problem.
